Geostationary.requires: a fixed slot at 36000 km above the equator
Geostationary.provides: continuous coverage of one hemisphere face, long signal path, predictable known position

Low Earth orbit constellation.requires: hundreds of satellites and rapid handover
Low Earth orbit constellation.provides: brief passes per satellite, massive redundancy, no single point of failure

Medium Earth navigation.requires: a precisely timed constellation at 20000 km
Medium Earth navigation.provides: timing and position service, weak received signal power at the ground

Highly elliptical polar.provides: long dwell over polar latitudes, coverage unavailable from geostationary

Uplink jamming.requires: transmitting toward the satellite with substantial power
Uplink jamming.provides: denial across the satellite's whole footprint, easily geolocated

Downlink jamming.provides: local denial only, low power, hard to find in clutter

Spoofed navigation signal.requires: the target to depend on received timing or position
Spoofed navigation signal.provides: false position accepted as true, no visible outage

Ground segment cyber intrusion.requires: network access to control or teleport facilities
Ground segment cyber intrusion.provides: control of the satellite itself, no radio emission, deniable

Kinetic anti-satellite strike.requires: an interceptor able to reach the orbit
Kinetic anti-satellite strike.provides: permanent destruction, long-lived debris, unambiguous act of war

Peer state military.provides: orbital reach, cyber capability, high-power emitters, willingness to escalate

Regional state.provides: purchased jammers, limited cyber capability, no orbital reach

Non-state armed group.provides: low-power local jamming only, no cyber or orbital capability

Criminal jamming for hire.requires: commercial jammers and a paying client
Criminal jamming for hire.provides: brief local disruption, profit motive, avoids attribution

Temporary local outage.requires: disruption bounded in time and place

Wide-area persistent denial.requires: sustained high power or control of the space segment

Undetected signal manipulation.requires: the victim continuing to trust the signal
Undetected signal manipulation.provides: deception, defeated the moment an outage is noticed

Permanent physical destruction.requires: kinetic or directed energy reach to orbit
Permanent physical destruction.provides: irreversible loss, debris field, act of war

_v1_notes.ORBIT|DENIAL METHOD: spoofing is N for everything except the navigation constellation - only a timing and position service can be spoofed into being trusted. A kinetic strike against a LEO constellation is N: hundreds of satellites with redundancy defeat the point, and against MEO and highly elliptical it is N on reach and on debris consequences at those altitudes.
_v1_notes.ORBIT|ATTACKER: LEO constellations and highly elliptical orbits are N for regional states, non-state groups and criminals: brief passes and rapid handover give nothing worth attacking with local jammers, and none has orbital reach.
_v1_notes.ORBIT|EFFECT SOUGHT: LEO and highly elliptical are N for wide-area persistent denial (redundancy defeats it) and N for permanent destruction (no proportionate reach).
_v1_notes.DENIAL METHOD|ATTACKER: uplink jamming is N for non-state groups and criminals - it requires substantial power aimed at orbit. Spoofing is N for both for the same reason. Cyber intrusion and kinetic strike are N for everyone except a peer state.
_v1_notes.DENIAL METHOD|EFFECT SOUGHT: uplink and downlink jamming are N for undetected manipulation, since an outage is visible by definition, and N for permanent destruction. Downlink is N for wide-area, being local only. Spoofing is N for outage effects, its whole purpose being that nothing appears wrong. Kinetic is N for anything except destruction.
_v1_notes.ATTACKER|EFFECT SOUGHT: non-state groups and criminals can achieve only temporary local outages. Regional states can reach wide-area denial but not undetected manipulation or destruction.
